subject: Decision Making
title: The Decision-Making Timeline
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Decision-Making Timeline.

hook.text: From oracle bones to AlphaGo, humans have spent 3,000 years building better ways to choose.

buildup.text: Oracles gave confidence. Probability gave measurement. Behavioral science revealed our flaws. AI gives speed.

discovery.text: Each era solved one problem and created another. Measurement created overconfidence. AI created opacity.

twist.text: The best modern decisions combine all eras: data, psychology awareness, structured frameworks, and human judgment.

climax.text: Decision science is not one breakthrough. It is layers of insight stacked over millennia, each correcting the last.

punchline.text: 3,000 years of tools. The best decisions use all of them together.

quiz.question: What is the key lesson from the history of decision-making?
options: Each era's solution created new problems, so the best approach combines all layers
